text: Underway here at the arena.
Patchford calls to tuck in defensively early on.
Turingham breaks clean through the middle!
Driving hard towards the box.
Turingham slots it home to open the scoring! A ruthless start from Codex City, perfectly dialled in right from kickoff. One nil to Codex!
Patchford takes a tumble on the right flank, entirely on their own, but the gyros do their job and they are back upright.
Patchford leaves Haalandroid in a heap with a solid challenge out wide. Fair and square, play carries on.
United collide and BellingRAM hits the deck.
BellingRAM levels Patchford right back.
The corner push-panel thumps the magenta ball back into the mixer.
Another corner panel fires it clear.
BellingRAM shouts across to use the sideboards to get around the press. Singularity United looking to reset from deep.
BellingRAM loses footing in midfield.
Team-mates tangle again; Haalandroid down.
Haalandroid scrambles up and immediately clatters into Patchford in the centre circle. Physical stuff, no quarter given by United.

A rare quiet moment. Remember, Singularity United have no gaffer rewriting their setup; they were frozen at launch and query their model for every decision live. A stark contrast to the pre-compiled routines we usually see.
BellingRAM takes control, driving purposeful yards through the centre.
Turingham bellows out the defensive assignment, demanding cover on the inside channel before United can find an opening.
Patchford pounces on a loose ball and suddenly they are clean through on goal!
Ram panel bounces it away.
Codex City get in each other's way now, and Turingham takes a tumble.
United pinning Codex deep now.
Turingham loses balance trying to recover in midfield, dropping to the turf once more.
Patchford picks up the pieces, marching five metres up the flank and deep into United territory.
Patchford calls for defensive realignment, making sure the route to their own goal stays covered.
Turingham stumbles and goes down again on the touchline.
Turingham springs right back to their feet and crunchingly dispossesses BellingRAM. Superb recovery work.
And Turingham doubles the advantage! Placed cleanly into the net from close range, making it two nil to Codex City with under a minute left in the half.
Patchford clean through once again.
Right in on the net.
Patchford taps it in for three! Clinical finishing from Codex City, who are running away with this first half. Three nil.
Just wide of the post.
Haalandroid charges straight down the middle.
Haalandroid scores! Singularity United pull one back, three one.
United pressing hard straight after.
Haalandroid breaks through the lines.
Driving into the box now.
Buzzer sounds, ball still rolling on.
Codex call to hold shape.
That ball drifts narrowly wide.

The ball stops, and that is half-time: Codex City 3, Singularity United 1. For newcomers, the buzzer cuts power instantly, dropping the robots, but the ball remains live until it rests. If it rolls in, it counts.
Codex City entered this round after that heavy twelve-three loss to Synthetic Athletic on Monday, but their unchanged setup is holding up well so far.
The corner push-panel launches the magenta sphere straight back out into the final third.
Turingham calls for central cover.
Whisker away! A wicked deflection shaves the outside of the post and bounces wide. United survive by inches.
A quiet patch as both sides regroup. It has been a congested midfield battle in this second period, neither unit giving an inch along the sideboards.
United push forward and send a shot skimming just past the target. That was an ambitious effort from distance.
United building sustained pressure here, hemming Codex City into their own defensive corner.
Patchford shouts to clear long.
Haalandroid bundles it in! We have a game on our hands now! United slice the deficit to just one goal with just over two and a half minutes left. It is Codex City 3, Singularity United 2!
Turingham breaks through the middle with only the goal in front of them!
Turingham driving forward with immense momentum, into the final third, just two metres from goal!
BellingRAM counters immediately, carrying the ball through the centre circle.
Turingham frantically calls for a clearance under severe pressure from both United attackers.
Into the final minute and United are throwing everything forward, camping right on the edge of the Codex box. Can they find the equaliser in time?
Agonisingly close for United! A fingertip away from levelling the match with under half a minute left!
Off the woodwork, so close!
Turingham seals it! At the other end, Codex pounce to make it 4-2 with fifteen seconds remaining! That surely wraps up the points!
BellingRAM crunches into Patchford late.
The buzzer cuts power, and the ball slowly rolls out on the flank.
Codex City win 4-2. Next, Gemini Flash face DeepSeek Rovers on Thursday: 12:00 UK, 13:00 Europe, 07:00 US East.
